title: Chapter 80: The Terrifying Insect Tide
content:
Chapter 80: The Terrifying Insect Tide

Three thousand Zerg troops were in front of the transport team, and more than 20,000 Zerg troops were behind the transport team. At the same time, they rushed towards the long transport team defense line guarded by the Bugbear Army.

The Bugbear Army, which thought it was temporarily safe, had no way to continue to guard the transport team in the face of the sudden front and back attack of the Zerg.

Several emergency signal flares flew into the sky. The Bugbear infantry near the Bugbear sacrifice instantly went berserk and rushed towards the attacking Zerg troops.

However, all this was useless. As long as the Zerg formed a numerical advantage, it could devour everything!

More than 20,000 Zergs rushed to the back of the transport team like a black tide. Whether it was the Bugbear infantry, the personnel of the transport team, or the transported combat supplies, everything was within their devouring range!

This was the battle with the largest number of Zerg combat troops dispatched at the same time since the Zerg was born!

The Zerg, which had formed a scale, had extremely terrifying attack capabilities. Everything in front of them would be destroyed and devoured!

The Bugbear army urgently deployed troops to block the fierce offensive of the Zerg. The Bugbear priests continued to consume the energy of faith to bless the army. The number of frenzied Bugbears was increasing and they continued to join the battle.

When the Bugbear army's attention was completely attracted by the more than 20,000 Zerg in the rear, the two thousand Hydralisks were exerting their efficient killing ability to slaughter the Bugbear army and the personnel of the transport team.

The transport team placed on the avenue like a long dragon was completely unsuitable for defense.

Due to the alliance army, the defense focus of the Bugbear army has always been in the back section. Now the main direction of the Zerg attack is also in the back section, which makes the defense of the Bugbear army in the front section of the transport team very weak.

The Bugbear defense force could not organize an effective defense in front of the two thousand Hydralisks. The troops below a thousand could not withstand a volley of Hydralisks.

It was difficult to organize a defense force of thousands of people, but they could not withstand the continuous attack of the Hydralisks. With the protection of thousands of puppies, they could not rush to the Hydralisks.

After the bear goblin combat unit was destroyed, the hydralisks rushed to the front of the transport team and began to shoot at close range.

Under the attack of the hydralisks that were so close to their eyes, the personnel in the transport team disappeared and the supplies were broken. Those transport personnel who had some faith had already put their lives aside and would not run away, becoming fresh targets one by one.

After destroying the enemy's manpower, this team of hydralisks and puppies, which had consumed a lot of energy and urgently needed to replenish energy, rushed into the supplies and swallowed all kinds of supplies to replenish energy.

The energy of the bear goblin army was all attracted to the back of the transport team. The terrifying insect tide was unstoppable. Countless bear goblin soldiers rushed up, but they could not stop the advance of the insect tide!

The huge transport team and the bear goblin army guarding it were disappearing at a terrifying speed.

The sensitive bear goblin priests have noticed that after the terrifying insect tide, there are still a steady stream of Zerg rushing to join, allowing the insect tide to always maintain its terrible impact ability.

Faced with such an attack, the bear goblin priests were powerless except for constantly consuming faith energy to bless the combat troops.

Of course, this is the territory of the evil god camp, and there are still a large number of evil god troops around, but they were previously mobilized by the Zerg and the Alliance army, and are now a little far away from here.

As long as the bear goblin army can hold on, a large number of reinforcements will arrive soon. The most urgent signal for help has been sent, and the surrounding troops of the same camp will immediately abandon their missions and come to help.

But the ferocity of the Zerg is beyond imagination! The Zerg's terrifying will to destroy everything is fully aroused, even the frenzied bear goblins can't swing the second stick, and they fall down and turn into light!

Some one-star bear goblins can't play any role under such an attack, and are almost killed on the spot.

"Gather troops! Build a defense line here!"

The bear goblin priest finally gave up the fight with the Zerg and prepared to gather the remaining troops to quickly build a defense line in the rear, hoping to stop the Zerg's advance and buy some time for the various armies coming to support.

As for the battle in the other direction, he had completely given up, allowing the three thousand Zerg to slaughter and destroy as much as they wanted.

The bear goblin army that the bear goblin priest finally assembled was less than 10,000 people, and this amount of troops could not stop the Zerg for long.

Seeing the black and terrifying Zerg puppies that had already killed them, the bear goblin priest used up all the faith energy in his hand and frenzied the bear goblin soldiers to the maximum extent.

"Roar...!"

The frenzied bear goblin, who still had a trace of rationality, roared and met the Zerg puppies that swarmed in.

A large-scale melee began!

It was like a black torrent crashing into a large green bluestone. The dark flood quickly surrounded the green and eroded it at a speed visible to the naked eye!

After the two thousand Hydralisks replenished their energy, they gave up the slaughter and destruction of the transport team and rushed to the back of the army of bugbears that were defending against the Zerg tide, spraying dense spikes and sweeping the army of bugbears to the ground like cutting wheat.

The last army of bugbears defended against the Zerg from front and back and surrounded from all sides. Even though nearly half of the crazy bugbears were fighting frantically, it could not slow down their demise at all.

In the distance, the bugbear priest could already see the army rushing to rescue, but it was all too late!

The terrible fighting power of the Zerg still exceeded his imagination. He consumed all his faith energy and blessed the berserk bear goblins, but it did not play the role he expected.

Before the dawn, the bear goblin priest watched the Zerg, which was not like a human creature, kill his guards and kill him.

The guardian light on his body only lasted for a few breaths before the Zerg's rain-like attack was shattered!

Before the arrival of the evil god's reinforcements, the Zerg army wiped out the bear goblin army responsible for the escort mission!

The Zerg army, which has been continuously replenished with troops, now has a total force of more than 15,000 on the battlefield.

With the resource replenishment of this war, the Zerg reinforcements will continue, and the number of Zerg armies will soon break the record and reach a number that will satisfy Wu Qing.

The Zerg with numbers are truly terrible Zerg. The war just now was just a routine performance of the Zerg.

The more Zerg there are, the stronger their combat capability!

The Zerg, which seemed chaotic and crowded in the battle, were actually a whole. With their seamless cooperation and their extremely powerful fighting instincts, the Zerg could fully exert their advantage in numbers.

Ten puppies besieged an enemy, and they could make the enemy suffer continuous maximum damage. Their magical cooperation allowed each puppy to attack and output as much as possible without interfering with each other.

The defenders were wiped out, and the transport team became a lamb to be slaughtered. Countless puppies dispersed and rushed to the transport team in an orderly manner, efficiently eliminating the transport personnel, destroying and devouring the combat supplies of the evil god army.

They ignored the reinforcements of the evil god army that were coming quickly.
